decision: Included 103 physical component labels plus 9 named logical rails/buses: BUS-SY230, BUS-AUX13A, BUS-AUX13B, BUS-NON1, BUS-416A/B/C/D, GND-GRID.

decision: Used BUS-AUX13A and BUS-AUX13B rather than overlay-looking BUS-AUX12A/B.
evidence: Raw schematic text under both thick aux rails reads 13.8 KV AUX BUS A/B and boxed labels read BUS-AUX13A/B.

decision: Did not create nodes for RAT-A, RAT-B, SAF A-D, ATS-A NORM/ALT, ATS-B NORM/ALT, ESF-K1A/K2A, train/division banners, or bay enclosure titles.
evidence: These appear as route labels, source labels, or area banners rather than standalone connectivity endpoints.

decision: Did not include WN-* wire topology endpoints, elbows, or junctions as matrix nodes.
evidence: wire_nodes.csv points are geometry aids only; task asks not to include anonymous topology points unless named logical nodes.

decision: Avoided adding edges at crossings unless there was a filled terminal dot or a named rail tap.
evidence: Legend says crossings without filled terminal dots are non-connections; raw schematic has many ATS/control line crossings near MCCs and control bay.

decision: Included BUS-NON1 and medium-confidence edges BUS-AUX13A--BUS-NON1 and BUS-NON1--TR-SAF-C.
evidence: Named non-safety 13.8 kV service bus is a thick rail with visible solid tap/drop; exact service relationship to TR-SAF-C is visually plausible but less clear than ordinary bus taps.

decision: Included dashed ESF/control/relay connections at medium/low confidence where named devices are visibly tied into the dashed network.
evidence: Control bay has filled terminal dots on CP-ESFAS, relays, instruments and long dashed paths; dense crossings make exact panel-to-relay mapping uncertain.

decision: Included ATS-to-charger-to-battery-to-DC-panel chains and 48 V rectifier/battery/JB/inverter/UPS panel chain.
evidence: Solid terminals and bottom-chain component alignment in raw schematic; inverter/rectifier long interconnects are lower confidence where line style appears dashed.

decision: Included GND-GRID as a named logical rail with low-confidence grounding-reference edges only for clear equipment columns/bottom components.
evidence: Raw schematic labels GND-GRID STATION GROUND GRID; dotted grounding conductors are visually pervasive and are not equivalent to power feeders.

decision: Included CB-TIE13 between BUS-AUX13A and BUS-AUX13B; CB-TIE-AB between BUS-416A/B; CB-TIE-CD between BUS-416C/D.
evidence: Each tie breaker is drawn in-line with adjacent named bus rails and marked N.O.

decision: Assigned AFW and MISV loads to MCC-1A1/MCC-1B1 and CCW loads to MCC-1A2/MCC-1B2.
evidence: Solid feeder leaves MCC side terminals to load symbols; nearby ATS vertical source labels cross without terminal dots.

decision: Assigned RHR loads to MCC-1C1/MCC-1D1; battery room heaters and CRHV fans to MCC-1C2/MCC-1D2, with fan edges medium confidence.
evidence: Solid feeders from MCC-1C2/MCC-1D2 route toward heaters/fans, but adjacent ATS-B source lines create visual ambiguity.
